summary.text: Alexander Valiensi Kent is an independent candidate for Wisconsin's 3rd District from La Crosse. He has a background in social work and philosophy, wrote a 2024 book on online voting, and describes his campaign as independent, voter-directed and accepting no money from donors.

paragraphs.text: Kent lives in La Crosse, Wisconsin. He earned a bachelor's degree from Viterbo University in 2014 and a graduate degree from the University of Chicago in 2016.

He describes his background as social work and philosophy, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as social work. His 2024 book, "Voter Directed Democracy," is, in his description, a political theory about bringing democratic republicanism online.
